description: Additive ECS/OpenShell aliases for privacy-filtered NeMo Relay spans received through APM Server; native APM fields are retained.

script.source: def labels = ctx.labels instanceof Map ? ctx.labels : [:]; def numeric = ctx.numeric_labels instanceof Map ? ctx.numeric_labels : [:]; if (!(ctx.event instanceof Map)) { ctx.event = [:]; } ctx.event.dataset = 'openshell.agent'; ctx.event.module = 'openshell'; ctx.event.provider = 'NVIDIA NeMo Relay'; def stage = labels.openinference_span_kind; if (stage == null && ctx.span instanceof Map) { stage = ctx.span.name; } if (stage != null) { ctx.event.action = stage.toString().toLowerCase().replace('relay.', ''); } if (ctx.message == null && ctx.span instanceof Map) { ctx.message = ctx.span.name; } if (!(ctx.openshell instanceof Map)) { ctx.openshell = [:]; } if (!(ctx.openshell.gateway instanceof Map)) { ctx.openshell.gateway = [:]; } if (!(ctx.openshell.sandbox instanceof Map)) { ctx.openshell.sandbox = [:]; } if (!(ctx.openshell.correlation instanceof Map)) { ctx.openshell.correlation = [:]; } else if (labels.openshell_policy_version != null) { ctx.openshell.policy.version = labels.openshell_policy_version; } if (labels.agent_session_id != null) { if (!(ctx.session instanceof Map)) { ctx.session = [:]; } ctx.openshell.request.id = labels.request_id; } if (labels.tool_call_id != null) { if (!(ctx.openshell.tool_call instanceof Map)) { ctx.openshell.tool_call = [:]; } ctx.openshell.tool_call.id = labels.tool_call_id;
